card.title: Galaxy Note 10 Lite Wi-Fi Grayed Out

source.title: Galaxy Note 10 Lite Wi-Fi Grayed Out

claims.statement: On the Galaxy Note 10 Lite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth refusing to enable has three usual causes: cold solder under the Wi-Fi IC, a failed Wi-Fi IC, or a CPU-side fault.
If pad diode readings are normal after removing the Wi-Fi IC, reball and refit it first; if no change, fit a known-good donor IC and trace any OL pads.
If an open line leads back to the CPU, or all lines test good but Wi-Fi still fails after IC work, reballing the CPU is the remaining fix.

procedure: Inspect and check for shorts around the Wi-Fi IC.
Remove the Wi-Fi IC and diode-check its pads.
Swap in a known-good donor Wi-Fi IC; trace OL pads.
Reball the CPU if lines are open on the CPU side or nothing else works.
card.caveats: Diode values under the IC are in an image on the source page. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
